sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Oral screening by low-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) testing (CPT code 87623*) is NOT REIMBURSABLE . • Oral screening by gene expression profiling by ribonucleic acid (RNA) sequencing (CPT code 0296U**) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE .

subsections.heading: Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans
content: Corporation; CGS Administrators, LLC; and Noridian Healthcare Solutions, LLC. **The payment criterion for 0296U applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to Palmetto GBA; Wisconsin Physicians Service Insurance Corporation; CGS Administrators, LLC; Novitas Solutions, In c., Noridian Healthcare Solutions, LLC, and First Coast Service Options, Inc.

rows.Code description:
Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); Human Papillomavirus (HPV), low-risk types (eg,
6, 11, 42, 43, 44)

Oncology (oral and/or oropharyngeal cancer), gene expression profiling by RNA sequencing at least 20
molecular features (eg, human and/or microbial mRNA), saliva, algorithm reported as positive or
negative for signature associated with malignancy
Proprietary test: mRNA CancerDetect™
Lab/Manufacturer: Viome Life Sciences, Inc
